blind_target.title: Common genetic variants in sex hormone pathway genes and papillary thyroid cancer risk.
blind_target.evidence_quote: The main objective of the current study was to replicate the most significant findings for PTC that we reported previously from an analysis of 1129 candidate genes based on 17525 tag single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) from the National Cancer Institute’s (NCI) rare cancer i-Select study ( 16–21 ).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Verdict scoped to this cited original; no aggregate count transferred. For reference 25, the explicit NKX2-1 contrast is failed; no explicit comparison settles its FOXE1 finding.

prior_decision.quote: From among 17525 tag SNPs in 1129 candidate genes evaluated in the NCI’s rare cancer i-Select study of PTC ( 16–21 ), the top 50 SNPs were selected for validation based on joint evaluation of lowest P values and per genotype odds ratio of 1.3 or greater.
prior_decision.reason: Insufficient evidence from the source: reference 19 is cited only within the pooled i-Select range (16–21) and the supplied text (without Supplementary Table 2) does not establish whether specific findings from reference 19 were tested or their outcome.

blind_target.title: Common single nucleotide polymorphisms in genes related to immune function and risk of papillary thyroid cancer.
blind_target.evidence_quote: The main objective of the current study was to replicate the most significant findings for PTC that we reported previously from an analysis of 1129 candidate genes based on 17525 tag single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) from the National Cancer Institute’s (NCI) rare cancer i-Select study ( 16–21 ).
blind_target.outcome_quote: In this independent and separate case–control study conducted in Germany, we replicated associations with PTC risk that we reported previously in SERPINA5 ( 21 ) and FTO ( 17 ) genes. Other candidate variants in EVPL , TICAM1 and SCARB1 previously identified ( 17 , 21 ) were also associated with PTC risk.
